meta.title: Slova — words and grammar
meta.description: Paste English words and study them. Grammar courses explain a rule, then drill it.
meta.ogTitle: Slova — paste a word list, learn the grammar
meta.ogDescription: Translations fill in from a shared dictionary of more than 8,000 words. Seven practice formats and grammar courses.

landing.heroBody: Type or paste words — the translations fill in by themselves. Grammar courses explain a rule and hand it straight back as practice. Come back when the words are due.
landing.statLexicon: words in the shared dictionary — translated, with recorded pronunciation
landing.statFormats: question formats for one word, from recognising it to writing it
landing.statRequest: for the whole list instead of forty — and most of the time, none at all
landing.stepPasteBody: Type or paste English words. Translations fill in as you add them.
landing.stepStudyBody: One card, seven formats. Recognising a word is easy; writing it is not.
landing.stepRuleBody: A grammar course: the rule on a card, then the drill. Present Simple is first.
landing.stepDueBody: The schedule brings the words back. Nothing to organise by hand.
landing.dictionaryTitle: Paste — and the translations are there.
landing.dictionaryBody: Type or paste. Most words come from a shared dictionary that already exists, with audio recorded. Only what is missing from it goes to a model — once.
landing.practiceBody: Recognise it, hear it, write it. The same word comes back from a different side each time — and the whole drill works from the keyboard.
landing.coursesTitle: A rule, and the drill right behind it.
landing.coursesBody: Longer than a training, shorter than a textbook. Every lesson shows the rule and then asks you to use it. Present Simple is first — six lessons, from forms to a test. Next is to be.
landing.closeTitle: Start with a list — or open a course.
landing.closeBody: Your first forty words will be translated before you finish reading this line.

legal.privacyMetaDescription: What Slova stores, who sees it, and how to ask for it to be deleted.
legal.privacyDescription: In short: we keep what the app needs to run, and nothing else. We do not sell data, show ads, or build profiles of you.
legal.whoBody: Slova is the vocabulary app at <site>slova.study</site>. There is no separate company behind the name. Questions: <email></email>.
legal.store1: Email and password. The password is stored only as a hash — even we cannot recover it.
legal.store2: Name and photo, if you signed in with Google. We take nothing else from your Google account.
legal.store3: Your words, translations and sets — what you added yourself.
legal.store4: The study schedule and your place in a course — so the app knows what to show today.
legal.storeElse: We do not collect a phone number, address or payment details, and we do not read anything outside the app.
legal.elseIntro: Only those without whom the service cannot run:
legal.else1: Neon — the database. AWS region us-east-1, Virginia, United States.
legal.else4: Google — if you chose to sign in with Google.
legal.else5: Anthropic — when a word is missing from the shared dictionary, it goes to a model. Only the word goes: no email, name, or anything about you.
legal.elseOutro: Nobody else. Data is not sold and not passed to advertising networks. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights count anonymous page visits and do not receive the contents of your words.
legal.whereBody: The database is Neon, AWS region us-east-1 (Virginia, United States). The app runs on Vercel, also in the United States; their nodes serve static files worldwide. Model requests are processed on Anthropic’s infrastructure. If you are in Europe: your data leaves the EU, and creating an account is how you agree to that.
legal.rights1: See it. Everything we store is visible in the app itself.
legal.rights2: Export it. Write to and we will send your dictionary and progress as one file.
legal.rights3: Correct it. Any word, translation and set is edited by you.
legal.rights4: Delete it. Write to and we will remove the email, words, sets, progress, sessions and tokens. That cannot be undone.
legal.sharedNote: Translations that have entered the shared dictionary stay there after the account is deleted: they are no longer tied to you and other people need them. If you want those removed too — write to us.
legal.howLongBody: Account data lasts as long as the account does. Write to <email></email> and we will delete the row.
legal.cookiesBody: A session cookie keeps you signed in. A language cookie remembers English or Russian. There are no advertising or tracking cookies. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights count anonymous visits, but do not tie them to the account or send the contents of your words.
legal.childrenBody: The app is meant for people aged 16 and over. If you are younger, use it with a parent’s consent.
legal.privacyChanges: If the rules change in a material way, we will email you before the changes take effect. The date of the last update is always at the top of this page.
legal.termsMetaDescription: How you may use Slova, and what the app does not promise.
legal.termsDescription: In short: use it in good health, do not break the service, and do not treat the translations as gospel.
legal.theAppBody: Slova is an app for learning English words and working through grammar. It is free to use. Creating an account means you agree to these terms.
legal.account1: One person, one account. Do not share access.
legal.account2: You are responsible for keeping the password. If access is lost — write to us.
legal.account3: You can delete the account at any time: write to <email></email>. Only your own progress goes with it.
legal.yourWordsBody: Lists, sets and notes belong to you. We do not publish them, show them to other users, or use them to train models.
legal.yourWordsException: There is one exception, and it matters: a word’s translation may enter the shared dictionary and become available to others — but only after an independent second source agrees with it. The word itself is not tied to you.
legal.forbidden1: Scrape the shared dictionary automatically, or create accounts by script.
legal.forbidden2: Deliberately spoil the shared dictionary with wrong translations.
legal.forbidden3: Add abusive content or advertising to the app.
legal.forbidden4: Try to bypass limits, break the service, or stop other people using it.
legal.forbiddenOutro: We may restrict access for that — and we will try to warn you first.
legal.translationsBody: Some translations come from a model, some from users. We try to keep them right, but we do not guarantee they are. Do not rely on Slova where a mistake is expensive: documents, medicine, law. Found an error — tell us, we will fix it.
legal.availabilityBody: We do not promise the app runs without interruption. There are updates and outages at suppliers. We try to keep those rare and short, but we guarantee nothing in advance.
legal.liabilityBody: The app is provided as-is. We are not liable for lost profit, lost time, or any indirect loss. What we do promise is to look after your data as described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
legal.sourcesBody: The frequency list the shared dictionary is built on is used under the rights-holder’s licence. The full list of sources and licences is available on request at <email></email>.
legal.termsChanges: The terms may change. We will email you about material changes in advance. Continuing to use the app after that means you accept the new version.
